description: See only the pull requests that ask for you by name, and read each one as a narrated review instead of a raw diff. The sidebar page lists your direct review requests with criticality tags, approvals, verdict, and age, sorted the way Diff Dad's own queue is, with a repo filter. An All tab embeds Diff Dad's command center, and a thread panel action opens the thread's own pull request review. Agents get a diffdad_review tool that returns a PR's verdict, TL;DR, and concerns as text. Requires Diff Dad's daemon running locally with its own GitHub token and AI provider, and the GitHub CLI logged in.
